name: hud_ui_list_selector_item_draw
description: HudUiListSelectorItem::Draw delegates to HudUiPanel::Draw and refreshes cached text bounds from virtual GetX/GetY, text width, and QueryTextHeight.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S comparison is deferred to the HudUiListSelectorItem or HUD panel source-file cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ba410 validates the direct HudUiPanel::Draw call, virtual GetX slot 0x64, optional RebuildTextRect slot 0x90, virtual GetY slot 0x68, direct HudUiPanel::QueryTextHeight call, and cached left/top/right/bottom writes.
The native command bind smoke constructs a HudUiListSelectorItem, drives Draw with seeded x/y, text width, text height, and padding fields, and verifies the recomputed cached text bounds.
